metric_notes.ttft_s: Time from immediately before HTTP request submission until first streamed content/reasoning chunk arrives.
metric_notes.request_tpot_s: Request-level average over streamed generation interval. Uses completion_tokens when usage is returned; otherwise falls back to emitted stream chunk count.
metric_notes.inter_chunk_latency: Measured between streamed chunks, not guaranteed to be a true per-token ITL distribution because a server chunk may contain zero, one, or multiple tokens.
metric_notes.throughput: Aggregate output tokens per wall-clock second for a profile/concurrency group when completion token counts are available.
